title: Acts-of-Kindness Ledger
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=relationship:checkin event=kindness
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as acts by person _time
| stats avg(acts) as weekly_acts by person
description: Counts the small thoughtful acts logged for each other each week, celebrating the little things that add up.
value: Noticing and recording kindness reinforces the habit and reminds a couple of the good they do for each other.
implementation: Log small acts of kindness into `index=personal`; review the weekly count per person.
visualization: Bar chart of weekly acts of kindness per person.
grandmaExplanation: It counts the little kind things you do for each other, celebrating the small gestures that matter.
